claim.statement: On Orvan -> Asgard, Maize, trade value fell by 55.97% (Oct-Dec 2026 vs Oct-Dec 2025) and volume by 61.42%. Volume fell further than value (61.42% against 55.97%), so the physical shortfall is larger than the value figure shows. Every month of the period is below its year-earlier level, so this is a sustained disruption, not a single bad month. Replacement supply is not measured (substitution is reported but no trade series measures it), so none of the loss has been shown to be replaced: the potential impact remains up to 55.97% of the route's baseline value.
